_doc: Cases for the term harness (P2.5, R10): shared/fixtures/terms/README.md. ios/Tools/term-harness passes them.

parse.name: lines, comments, blank lines and CRLF
parse.text:
# en corpus

en>vi	I booked a Grab to the airport.	Grab	Grab
vi>en	Tàu từ Hà Nội vào Huế chạy lúc tám giờ.	Hà Nội	Hanoi

expected.source: I booked a Grab to the airport.
Tàu từ Hà Nội vào Huế chạy lúc tám giờ.

parse.name: zh-Hans direction
parse.text: zh-Hans>vi	我叫了一辆 Grab 去机场。	Grab	Grab

expected.source: 我叫了一辆 Grab 去机场。

parse.name: three columns
parse.text: en>vi	I booked a Grab.	Grab

parse.name: five columns
parse.text: en>vi	a Grab	Grab	Grab	extra

parse.text: ja>vi	Grab を予約しました。	Grab	Grab

parse.name: empty field

evaluate.name: kept: verbatim term
evaluate.line: en>vi	I booked a Grab to the airport.	Grab	Grab
evaluate.masked: I booked a Zorvik1 to the airport.

expected.output: Tôi đã đặt Grab ra sân bay.

evaluate.name: lost: invented placeholder, term dropped
evaluate.line: en>vi	I booked a Grab to the airport.	Grab	Grab
evaluate.masked: I booked a ⟦1⟧ to the airport.

I booked a Grab to the airport.
expected.output: Tôi đã đặt xe ra sân bay.
